footer.notice: Bonsai (research project), Berlin · Data kept in the EU (Frankfurt)

landing.title: One bonsai. Its history, with dates.
landing.lead: Bonsai is a small research project. It helps you keep track of one bonsai: photos, what you did to it, and how it changes.
landing.promise1: Create a tree and look up or type its species.
landing.promise2: Import the photos you already have, with their dates, and add moments.
landing.promise3: Compare two moments side by side: then and now.
landing.promise4: Export everything or delete it at any time.
landing.not1: No care advice, no diagnosis, no recommendations.
landing.not2: No reminders, no emails beyond the sign-in link.
landing.not3: Not a social network. Your record is private unless you share it yourself.
landing.status: Status: foundation (Phase 0). Creating a tree, importing photos and comparing arrive over the coming weeks.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: We send you a one-time link by email. No password.
signIn.sentBody: If the address is right, the link is on its way. It is valid for one hour.
signIn.legal: To send the link we process your email address (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). See the <privacy>privacy notice</privacy>.
signIn.errorInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
signIn.errorLink: The link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
signIn.errorSend: The link could not be sent. Please try again in a minute.

consent.title: Before you start
consent.intro1: Bonsai is a small research project. It helps you keep track of one bonsai: photos, what you did to it, and how it changes. It gives no care advice.
consent.intro2: To make the site work we store your email address and the photos, dates and notes you add about your tree. Your data is kept in the EU (Frankfurt). Your record is private unless you share it yourself. You can export everything or delete your account at any time.
consent.required: Required. I am at least 16 years old and have read the privacy notice. (Contract, Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR)
consent.optional: Optional. I agree that Bonsai records how I use the site (which pages I open, when I add photos or notes, when I come back) to research whether a tree record like this is useful. Results are reported only in aggregate, without names, email addresses or photos. I can withdraw this consent at any time in Settings; the site works the same either way. (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR)

myTree.title: My tree
myTree.emptyBody: Creating a tree, importing photos and comparing arrive with the next release. Your account and settings are already here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Switches the interface and is stored with your account.
settings.researchOn: You agreed to the recording of your usage (version {version}, {date}).
settings.researchOff: You have not agreed to the recording of your usage. The site works the same.
settings.researchWithdrawnAt: Withdrawn on {date}. Events recorded before then were pseudonymised.
settings.researchText: Bonsai records how you use the site (which pages you open, when you add photos or notes, when you come back) to research whether a tree record like this is useful. Results are reported only in aggregate, without names, email addresses or photos.
settings.exportBody: A JSON file with your account, trees, moments and events. Photos are included as links valid for 24 hours.
settings.deleteBody: Deletes your account and all trees, moments and photos immediately and permanently. Events lose their link to your account and remain only in aggregate.
settings.deleteError: The confirmation word does not match.
settings.deleted: Your account and data have been deleted.

impressum.title: Impressum
impressum.note: Note: name, postal address and the responsible person required by § 5 DDG are not yet entered. They must be added before public launch (open founder decision, see CONTENT-CONSENT-v0.3).
